{{Quote|I'm Sidon Ithano. I don't die so easily.|The Crimson Corsair speaks|<ref name="Lost Treasure" />}}
'''Sidon Ithano''', nicknamed the "'''Crimson Corsair'''," the "'''Blood Buccaneer'''," the "'''Red Raider'''," the "'''Silent Scourge of the Lost Clusters'''," the "'''Scourer of Adratharpe 7'''," and the "'''Conqueror of the Droid Syndicate'''," was a [[Gender|male]] [[Delphidian]] [[pirate]] [[captain]] who lived in the [[Outer Rim Territories]] in the [[Standard decade|decades]] following the conclusion of the [[Galactic Civil War]]. Ithano, who wore a distinctive [[Color|red]] [[Kaleesh]] [[Helmet|mask]], led a [[Sidon Ithano's pirate crew|crew]] of pirates, and gained a reputation as the best pirate in the region. He and his crew discovered the remains of the downed ''[[Obrexta III]]'', a [[Starship|ship]] which had been in service to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] exactly 50 [[standard year]]s prior during the [[Clone Wars]], and raided it under the assumption that they would find valuable [[kyber crystal]]s that once belonged to [[Count]] [[Dooku]]. Instead they found a [[Galactic Republic]] [[clone trooper]] named [[Kix]], who had been [[Cryo-cycle stasis|frozen in stasis]], and the locations of former Separatist bases.

==Biography==
===Early life and pirate career===
{{Quote|Lower ye shields and come about!|The orders Ithano would issue to announce his arrival|<ref name="Visual">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>}}
[[File:SidonIthanoStairs-SWBC65.png|thumb|right|250px|Ithano stands at the entrance to the ''Meson Martinet'']]
A [[Gender|male]] [[Delphidian]] from the [[Delphidian Cluster]],<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition" /> Sidon Ithano lived as a [[pirate]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[the galaxy]] during the years leading into the [[Cold War|conflict]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]].<ref name="Lost Treasure" /> In his past, he had been indoctrinated by the [[Kaleesh]] [[Elder (title)|elders]] in the [[warru'zan]], the bloodhalls of [[Kalee]]<ref name="Sinister Secret of the Binary Star">{{InsiderCite|234|Galactic Tales: The Crimson Corsair and the Sinister Secret of the Binary Star}}</ref> in [[Wild Space]],<ref name="Appendix">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}}</ref> where he had read about [[species|creatures]] like [[Starweird]], a semi-corporeal [[Ghost (folklore)|spirits]] believed to haunt the [[Hyperspace route|hyperspace lanes]]. At some point, the sacred rituals took place for Ithano, only for [[stormtrooper]]s to arrive and for him to put on the crimson mask of the trickster [[Deity|god]] [[Ithano (god)|Ithano]] for the first time.<ref name="Sinister Secret of the Binary Star" />

Ithano became the most notorious [[thief]] of his species. He earned the title of "[[Color|Crimson]] Corsair"<ref name="Lost Treasure" /> and similar nicknames,<ref name="HC 59">{{HelmetCollectionCite|59|Helmets}}</ref> such as "[[Blood]] Buccaneer" or "Red Raider,"<ref name="Smuggler's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide]]''</ref> due to his choice of [[Clothing|garb]]: he wore crimson [[robe]]s that covered most of his body,<ref name="Lost Treasure" /> and a [[Kaleesh mask|mask]]<ref name="HC 59" /> he had stolen from the Kaleesh,<ref name="Absolutely">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> which he used to hide his Delphidian heritage.<ref name="HC 59" /> The [[Sidon Ithano's helmet|helmet mask]] was<ref name="Lost Treasure" /> a traditional,<ref name="Spanish Lost Treasure">"[[The Crimson Corsair and the Lost Treasure of Count Dooku]]" (Spanish version)</ref> red Kaleesh item<ref name="SidonDB">{{Databank|sidon-ithano|Sidon Ithano}}</ref> made of [[plasteel]]<ref name="Lost Treasure" /> and [[ionnite]]<ref name="Sinister Secret of the Binary Star" /> and of ancient origin.<ref name="German HC 59">{{HelmetCollectionCite|59|Helmets}} (German version)</ref> Beyond his own past connection to the Kaleesh<ref name="Sinister Secret of the Binary Star" /> and his effort to hide his Delphidian identity,<ref name="HC 59" /> Ithano wore the red mask because he was inspired by the merciless species of the Kaleesh<ref name="Chewbacca">{{EncyclopediaCite|Chewbacca and Other Aliens of the Rebellion and the Resistance}}</ref> and to invoke the appearance of blood.<ref name="HC 59" />

Ithano served alongside the [[Weequay]] pirate [[Scorza]] aboard the ''[[New Gilliland]]'', an Outer Rim-centered [[cruiser]], for several years. However, the ''New Gilliland'' was destroyed by the [[Hutt Clan|Hutt syndicate]] after Scorza [[Treason|betrayed]] Ithano and others to the [[Hutt]]s. The Corsair managed to survive the attack and even gained enough [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to finance [[Sidon Ithano's pirate crew|his own crew]]—though he did not invite Scorza to join him, as Scorza had betrayed him; a decision that Scorza took personally and vowed to have revenge against Ithano for.<ref name="Lost Treasure" />

Ithano's crew of pirates headquartered on the Corsair's [[starship]], the ''[[Meson Martinet]]'', which he [[captain]]ed, and in a [[Unidentified derelict bar|cantina]] on an Outer Rim [[desert]] [[planet]], [[Ponemah Terminal]]. The Corsair and his crew fought in several battles over the years, including at [[Adratharpe 7]], where Ithano [[Skirmish of Adratharpe 7|won]] much renown: he was the fiercest fighter at the battle. Ithano was also the first pirate to ever sail the [[Lost Clusters]]<ref name="Lost Treasure" /> in Wild Space,<ref name="Appendix" /> a treacherous location located beyond the Outer Rim. Ithano rarely spoke, relying instead on his loyal crew to know his orders by their brotherly bond or through hand gestures—which only furthered his reputation as a legendary pirate.<ref name="Lost Treasure" /> He was given the nicknames "Silent Scourge of the Lost Clusters," "Scourer of Adratharpe 7,"<ref name="Aliens of the Galaxy" /> and "Conqueror of the [[Droid]] Syndicate."<ref name="Sinister Secret of the Binary Star" />

===The lost treasure of Count Dooku===
At the mark of 50 [[standard year]]s after the [[Clone Wars]], Ithano's crew consisted of [[Quiggold]], an [[Amphibian|amphibious]] [[Gabdorin]]—who was also Ithano's [[First Mate|first mate]]—the [[Ishi Tib]] [[Pendewqell]], an [[Arcona]] named [[Reeg Brosna]], [[Reveth]], a female red-skinned [[Twi'lek]], and a porcine [[Gamorrean]] who went by the name of [[Na'Vrokk|Squeaky]].<ref name="Lost Treasure" />

[[File:Sidon_Ithano_SWSG.png|thumb|left|200px|Captain Sidon Ithano]]
While waiting out the [[Standard day|day]] in the Ponemah cantina one day, Ithano and his six crew members received a transmission that dated back to the Clone Wars. The message was relayed from [[B1-CC14]], a [[B1-series battle droid]] that was stationed aboard [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] cruiser, the ''[[Obrexta III]]'', that had [[Attack in an unidentified sector|crash-landed]] on Ponemah during the Clone Wars with the treasure of [[Count]] [[Dooku]],<ref name="Lost Treasure" /> the political leader of the Separatist party,<ref name="Heroes both Sides">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> aboard. Pendewqell persuaded his captain and the crew to seek out the crashed cruiser and claim the treasure before other pirates claimed it their own, so Ithano and his crew quickly [[Hunt for Dooku's Treasure|set out]] to the southern region of the planet, known as the [[Sea of Sand]], which was plagued by lightning storms, [[magma]] geysers, and 15-[[meter]] waves of caustic sand that acted as Penohma's [[Ocean|sea]]. Consequently, starships could not fly under those conditions; so, Ithano and his crew took off in their [[sail barge]], the custom red-painted [[Shrike (sail barge)|''Shrike'']].<ref name="Lost Treasure" />

While journeying, Ithano's crew came to the conclusion that Dooku's treasure was the collection of [[Jedi]] [[lightsaber]] [[kyber crystal]]s that the Count<ref name="Lost Treasure" /> had collected during the Clone Wars,<ref name="Dark Disciple">''[[Dark Disciple]]''</ref> which were worth a massive fortune on the [[black market]]. However, unknown to the Corsair and his crew at the time, several other criminal gangs had taken pursuit of the ''Shrike'', including Scorza and his gang, the [[Gray Gundarks]], a [[swoop]] biker gang.<ref name="Lost Treasure" />

The Corsair's sail barge soon entered the Sea of Sand, but a massive [[sandstorm]]-tornado pulled the ''Shrike'' off-course. Ithano gestured to Quiggold, who translated the message to fire a [[kinetic disruptor]] torpedo into the tornado and thereby freeze the storm and allow them to continue on their journey. Brosna and Quiggold fired the torpedo as ordered, though it had a delayed trigger and did not immediately detonate.<ref name="Lost Treasure" />

Scorza, however, had caught up to the ''Shrike'' and fired [[Scorza's skiff|his skiff's]] [[laser cannon]]s at Ithano's vessel, which knocked Brosna overboard and did significant damage to the barge. The Corsair launched [[Magnetic harpoon|tow cables]] onto Scorza's [[skiff]] so Scorza would have to pull them away from the tornado. However, the Gray [[Gundark]]s interrupted with their attack; firing and boarding both vessels indiscriminately. As the battle raged, a geyser of lava erupted and set many of the bikers ablaze, as well as both pirate vessels. Ithano dueled the bikers with his [[Vibroblade|vibro-sword]], until Scorza confronted him to have his revenge, shooting the two bikers with a [[blaster]] and taunting the captain with his tale of revenge. The Corsair, however, spoke, telling Scorza that he did not recognize the old Weequay pirate; Ithano had met a lot of Weequay pirates in his life. Scorza, infuriated, attacked his former friend with his sword. Ithano quickly gained the upper hand and kicked the Weequay over the railing of the ''Shrike'' just as the kinetic disruptor detonated, freezing the vortex in place like a statue. The wreckage of the ''Obrexta III'' was just on the other side of the vortex, and Ithano and his crew raced towards it, leaving their enemies to die in the flames.<ref name="Lost Treasure" />

The Corsair and his crew reached an [[airlock]] to the cruiser soon thereafter, though Ithano's crew was not the first to reach the wreckage: the bodies of the members of the [[Fangs of the Hutt]] lay dead inside the Separatist ship, [[poison]]ed by [[durilliam]] gases that had been leaking for over five decades. Ithano and his crew had come prepared, unlike the other criminals; the Corsair and his crew donned [[rebreather]]s and entered the wreckage. The cruiser was cluttered with deactivated [[battle droid]]s and corroded metal, so they stepped carefully through the maze of a ship until the reached the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the [[battleship]]. A [[ion storm]] had swept the region months before, which was causing the ship and battle droids aboard to slowly reactivate. The Corsair expressed his worriment about the danger the droids posed to Quiggold, so Quiggold questioned Pendewqell, respectively if he was an idiot for bringing the crew there—it had been Pendewqell's idea to begin the endeavor in the first place.<ref name="Lost Treasure" />

[[File:Crimson_Corsair_SaV.png|thumb|right|200px|Ithano oversees cargo being loaded onto his ship.]]
Ithano and his companions raced through the ship to find and claim the lost treasure before the droids could pose a threat. Soon after, the crew located the ship's vault and surgically opened it with blaster fire and explosives. What they found within surprised even the Corsair: A [[cryo-cycle stasis pod]] with a [[sleep]]ing being within—not lightsaber kyber crystals. Pendewqell reasoned that even though it wasn't the crystals, it had to be valuable because it was in the vault. Ithano agreed and gestured for his crew to awaken the pod. They did so, and a [[Galactic Republic]] [[clone trooper]] emerged. The [[trooper]] had learned of a [[Sith]] plot to [[Order 66|destroy]] the [[Jedi Order]] during the Clone Wars, but had been captured and put in [[Cryo-cycle stasis|stasis]] by Dooku before he could save the Jedi and the Republic. The trooper, [[Kix|CT-6116]], or "Kix," was a [[medic]], and he feverishly explained that he needed to save the Republic by reporting what he had learned to [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]]. Before Ithano could further question the [[Cloning|clone]], Kix fell into unconsciousness.<ref name="Lost Treasure" />

Quiggold berated Pendewqell for leading them on the foolhardy treasure hunt that had led to a discovery that did not matter anymore. Pendewqell fled fearing the Corsair would punish him greatly for endangering their lives on a worthless hunt. Ithano was upset and Pendewqell's hasty departure, but told his crew to carry the unconscious clone and run for back to the ''Shrike'' as the ''Obrexta III'' began to fall apart, and the droids reactivated around them. However, Scorza emerged and pointed a blaster at the pirates, demanding they stop. Quiggold, like Ithano, did not recognize Scorza, but watched in contempt as a [[squad]] of [[B2-series super battle droid]]s walked up behind Scorza and shot him; allowing Ithano and his crew to escape once more. They reached the airlock from where they had entered just in time to watch a massive [[sand worm]] devour the ''Shrike''. The Corsair was becoming exasperated at the turn of events, and at losing his sail barge. So at Quiggold's suggestion, they headed for the ''Obrexta III's'' [[escape pod]]s.<ref name="Lost Treasure" />

[[File:CrimsonCorsairCrewRaid-Ashcan.png|thumb|left|300px|Sidon Ithano's crew raiding a Separatist holdout.]]
Only one escape pod remained active, and not everyone could fit in the pod, so Ithano selflessly stayed behind in the damned ship, and sent his crew to safety in the pod, just as a sand worm tore through the wreck, causing it to explode. Ithano survived, however, and retrieved the ''Obrexta III''{{'s}} [[Memory bank|memory core]], which contained the locations of every base and droid factory the Separatists ever operated. The Corsair eventually escaped the wreckage and the Sand of Sea: three weeks after awakening Kix, the Corsair made it back to their cantina—much to the shock of everyone, though Quiggold had faithfully refused to accept that his friend had been killed. Ithano gave Kix the memory core, who assured everyone that they would be rich if they plundered the forgotten bases. Kix then joined Ithano's crew as their guide, because he was an expert in Clone Wars-era [[Grand Army of the Republic|military]] technology. Quiggold, however, inquired as to how the Crimson Corsair had escaped the fire, sand, sand worms, and droids. Ithano decided to speak, saying only that he was Sidon Ithano; and that he would not die that easily.<ref name="Lost Treasure" />

With Kix having joined Ithano's crew, they proceeded to raid more [[Separatist holdouts]]. [[Separatist holdout (Unidentified swamp astronomical object)|One]] was located in a [[Unidentified swamp astronomical object|misty]] [[swamp]], where Ithano, Reveth and Kix were ambushed by B1 battle droids, which were unearthing themselves from the ground, trying to reach the crew. [[C-3PO]] later told this story to some visitors and described it as "spooky."<ref name="Ashcan">[[Star Wars Adventures Ashcan|''Star Wars Adventures'' Ashcan]]</ref>

===Maz Kanata's castle===
[[File:Finn_with_Sidon_Ithano_and_Quiggold.png|thumb|right|250px|Ithano making a deal with Finn.]]
Sometime later, Ithano and Quiggold visited [[Takodana Castle]] thirty years after the [[Battle of Endor]] where a fugitive First Order defector named [[Finn]] offered to join their crew in exchange for work and safe passage into the Outer Rim Territories, away from the First Order's reach. However, before Finn made his way on board the ''Meson Martinet'', the pirates' departure was interrupted by the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destruction]] of the [[Hosnian system]], which could be seen in the skies above [[Takodana]].<ref name="Episode VII">{{Film|VII}}</ref>

===Selling super battle droids===
Over time, First Order patrols had severely diminished the loot captured by Ithano and his crew. To counter this, Ithano found new business selling captured weapons amid the uncertainty of the [[First Order-Resistance War]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> 

[[File:IcyAsteroid-TheMutiny.png|thumb|left|250px|Ithano became an weapons dealer during the First Order-Resistance War.]]
In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> not too long before the [[Battle of Exegol]] Ithano made a substantial sale of a [[B1's B2-series super battle droid battalion| vintage cache of super battle droids]] and one [[B1 (Colossus)|B1]] droid to the [[Quarren]] pirate [[Kragan Gorr]] and his [[Warbird gang|Warbird pirates]],<ref name="TROS VD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> who bought them to assist in their [[Mutiny on the Colossus|final attempt to seize control]] of the [[supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''. Gorr asked how the Crimson Corsair had been faring of late; but Ithano told him cut the pleasantries and ask if he wanted the cargo or not. When Gorr attempting to haggle the Corsair due to the merchandise looked worn out and ask if they can lower the price Ithano respond with a gestures his [[blaster rifle]], forcing Gorr to back down and accept the deal. He ordered [[Drell]] give the [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to Ithano.<ref name="The Mutiny">{{Resistance|The Mutiny}}</ref> However, Ithano found it hard to spend his credits following the destruction of many of his favorite haunts.<ref name="TROS VD" />

===Exegol===
[[File:RoseBeaumontKaydel-CGSWG.png|thumb|right|300px|Ithano (background) fought the Sith Eternal with the Resistance.]]
After the [[Final Order]] fleet was revealed to the galaxy and threatened to bring everyone under the rule of the resurrected [[Darth Sidious]], who had also revealed his own survival to the galaxy and brought the First Order under his control via [[Allegiant General]] [[Enric Pryde]], Ithano participated in the [[Battle of Exegol|battle]] against the [[Sith Eternal]] on the planet [[Exegol]], joining the [[Exegol landing team|Resistance ground team]] that was in charge of destroying the fleet's [[navigation tower]] on the surface. When Pryde learned of this plan, he ordered the navigation instead be redirected to his [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|Steadfast]]'', resulting in the ground team redirecting their effort by landing on the [[Star Destroyer]]'s hull itself. Ithano took part in the battle on the ''Steadfast''.<ref name="Episode IX" />

Following a battle with [[Sith trooper]]s who attempted to defend the command ship's navigation tower, the Resistance successfully destroyed it, trapping the Final Order in Exegol's atmosphere and leaving it easy prey for the Resistance fleet and the [[Citizens' Fleet]] rallied by General [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian]]. Furthermore, Sidious himself was destroyed by the [[Jedi]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], ending the threat of the Sith once and for all. Later, Ithano, along with the allied Citizens' Fleet, joined the Resistance at their [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] on [[Ajan Kloss]] in celebration of victory against Sidious, the Sith Eternal, and the First Order,<ref name="Episode IX" /> which crumbled<ref name="TSWB">''[[The Star Wars Book]]''</ref> without the military support of the Sith Eternal due to a [[Uprising against the First Order|galaxy-wide uprising]] inspired by the victory at Exegol.<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:SidonIthano-USCTFA.png|thumb|left|150px|Ithano carried a blaster rifle claimed from a member of Kanjiklub.]]
Sidon Ithano<ref name="Lost Treasure" /> had dark gray skin<ref name="Aliens of the Galaxy" /> and black [[eye]]s<ref name="VE" /> and stood 1.83 [[meter]]s tall.<ref name="TFA head to head" /> Ithano's face was impossible to read through the red Kaleesh mask he constantly wore, and he rarely talked, and when he did, it was in a raspy, mechanical voice. Being a man of few words, he would rather let his first mate, Quiggold, speak.<ref name="Lost Treasure" /> His deep-set eyes and dark, deeply striated skin could be seen in some light, but few ever came close enough to see the Crimson Corsair and lived to tell the tale.<ref name="HC 59" /> Ithano would often let his reputation lead to victory, simply ordering the target vessel to lower their [[Deflector shield|shields]] and change direction. This order was not one any starship crew wished to hear, inducing fear in those who heard the order via their ship's [[comm unit]].<ref name="Visual" /> [[Spacer|Space travelers]] were terrified of hearing the well-known pirate's catchphrase, "Lower your shields and surrender!" making him a major source of dread.<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref>

==Skills and abilities==
The Crimson Corsair was a master strategist capable of predicting his foe's moves.<ref name="Crime Lords">[[Tales of Villainy: The Crimson Corsair and the Crime Lords of the Barren Rim]]</ref> He was also a skilled sharpshooter.<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Equipment==
Sidon Ithano wore an [[armorweave]]-lined [[cape]]<ref name="Visual" /> as well as a highly polished,<ref name="HC 59" /> modified<ref name="Sinister Secret of the Binary Star" /> Kaleesh helmet<ref name="Visual" /> with [[ear]] flares<ref name="TFA Novelization">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' novelization]]</ref> that sealed his [[Rebreather|breather line]] and shielded him from the [[vacuum]] of [[Realspace|space]].<ref name="Sinister Secret of the Binary Star" /> He often carried a [[Captain Ithano's blaster rifle|blaster rifle]], proudly captured from a [[Kanjiklub]]ber,<ref name="Visual" /> and additionally possessed a [[Longswat-44 sniper blaster rifle]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Maz_castle_cross_section.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Patrons of Maz Kanata's castle, including the "Crimson Corsair"]]
Sidon Ithano was created for the 2015 film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars:'' Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] and was first pictured in a [[Wikipedia:Vanity Fair (magazine)|''Vanity Fair'']] article released [[May 4]], [[2015]], which included a group photo of characters in Maz Kanata's castle.<ref name="Vanity Fair">{{WebCite|url=http://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2015/05/star-wars-force-awakens-photos|text=Adam Driver and Lupita Nyong'o's Characters Revealed in Exclusive Star Wars: The Force Awakens Photos|author=Leibovitz, Annie|date=2015-05-04|work=[[Wikipedia:Vanity Fair (magazine)|Vanity Fair]]|archivedate=20150504170503}}</ref> Ithano first appeared in "[[The Crimson Corsair and the Lost Treasure of Count Dooku]]," a short story by [[Landry Q. Walker]], which was published as an [[eBook]] on [[November 29]].<ref name="Lost Treasure" />

Ithano was portrayed by [[Cavin Cornwall]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars:'' Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']].<ref name="Cornwall">{{Topps|set=2019 Topps Star Wars: Journey to The Rise of Skywalker|cardname=Cavin Cornwall as Sidon Ithano|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/215324/cid/13667768/2019-Topps-Star-Wars-Journey-to-Star-Wars-The-Rise-of-Skywalker---Autographs-NNO-Cavin-Cornwall}}</ref> Cornwall was not given credit to his role, but rather was credited as a "creature and droid performer".<ref name="Episode VII" /> He was voiced by [[David Acord]] in the film,<ref name="Voices">{{SW|url=news/from-blast-that-x-wing-to-traitor-the-voices-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens|text=From "Blast That X-wing!" to "Traitor!": The Voices of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''}}</ref> who reprised his role in the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' episode "[[The Mutiny]]."<ref name="The Mutiny" />
